label: Ventricle volume (cm3) - Longitudinal (phase 1 and 2 only) - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Ventricle volume (cm3) - Longitudinal (phase 1 and 2 only) - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 brain volumes measured from T1 MRI as part of the longitudinal pipeline. Can be used for longitudinal analysis with phase 2 brain volumes. Note that boundary shift integral measures have also been quantified for some regions (whole brain, ventricles, hippocampus) which provide more precise estimates of volume change between phase 1 and 2 compared to indirectly calculating the difference in volume between each time-point - see library file - I46P2_brainVolumes_L
truly_longitudinal: Ventricle volume (cm3) - Longitudinal (phase 1 and 2 only) - Insight46 phase 2
cat_rows: This category contains variables related to the brain volumes (longitudinal measures) parcellated from T1 MRI (phases 1 and 2) from the MRI brain imaging carried out on the participants taking part in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values and distribution outside 5th and 95th percentiles removed from both the plot and the statistics above.
